scenes.name: SCORE THE SURVIVORS
lines: Cross out the multiples of two or five from one through ten. One, three, seven and nine survive.
在 1 到 10 中划去 2 或 5 的倍数，只剩 1、3、7、9。
One scores plus one. Three and seven score minus one each. Nine contains a repeated prime, so it scores zero. The total is minus one.
1 得一分，3 和 7 各扣一分，9 有重复质因数，得零分。总分为负一。

scenes.name: PAIR DIVISORS
lines: The first route combines shorter sums indexed by squarefree divisors of ten. At six, the eligible divisors of both six and ten are one and two.
第一条路将 10 的无平方因子的因数对应的短和相加。对下标 6，6 与 10 的公因数只有 1 和 2。
Their weights are plus one and minus one, so six cancels. At seven only the divisor one remains. That is how the sieve reappears.
它们的权重一正一负，6 因此被消去。对下标 7，只剩因数 1。筛选就这样重新出现。

scenes.name: SPLIT PRIME POWERS
lines: The second route allows every power of an eligible prime. Four and eight are allowed even though neither divides ten.
第二条路允许使用符合条件的质数的所有幂。4 和 8 虽不整除 10，却都符合条件。
At eight, split off one, two, four or eight. The remaining factors are eight, four, two and one. Only the last two scores survive, and they cancel.
对 8，分出 1、2、4 或 8，余下的因数分别是 8、4、2、1。只有最后两个得分不为零，且正负相消。

scenes.name: MOVE THE CUTOFF
lines: Both cancellations happen one term at a time. So the cutoff can be moved independently of the number used for the sieve.
两种消去都是逐项发生的。因此截点可以独立移动，不必等于筛选用的参数。
Jamie Morken asked about the diagonal. Ma and Zhang explain the two routes, building on earlier identities of Sander and Sander and Ramaré.
Jamie Morken 提出对角线情形。Ma 和 Zhang 在 Sander 与 Sander、Ramaré 的早期恒等式基础上解释了两条路线。
